[[File:Pisani - Giardino aritmetico, 1646 - 4648193.tif|thumb|''Giardino aritmetico'', title page]]

'''Giovanni Battista Pisani''', also known as '''Gio. Battista Pisani''', was a [[17th-century]] [[Genoa|Genoese]] [[mathematician]].<ref>{{Cite book|first=Giuseppe|last=Cerboni|title=Sur l'importance d'unifier les études de la comptabilité|location= Rome|publisher=Imprimerie héritiers Botta|year=1887|p=132|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=AP8nAAAAYAAJ&pg=PA132|language=fr}}</ref>

== Biography ==
He wrote ''The First Book of Modern Cursive Letters'' (''Il primo libro di lettere corsive moderne'', 1641) about [[calligraphy]],<ref>{{Cite book|first=Joyce Irene|last=Whalley|title=The Pen's Excellencie: Calligraphy of Western Europe and America|location=Tunbridge Wells|publisher=Midas Books|year=1980|pages=188, 205|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=b4_gAAAAMAAJ}}</ref> followed by other educational works, ''Arithmetic Memorial'' (''Memoriale aritmetico'', 1644) and ''Arithmetic Garden'' (''Giardino aritmetico'', 1646), intended to solve arithmetic problems that were especially related to [[merchant]] activity.<ref>{{Cite book|location=Genoa|title=Atti della Accademia ligure di scienze e lettere|publisher=Accademia ligure di scienze e lettere|year=2003|page=241|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=NkcoAQAAIAAJ|language=it}}</ref>
